hero: In a tertiary hospital nephrology clinic in Batangas City, a Filipino nephrology fellow sits across a small desk from a 58-year-old Filipina public school teacher in her school uniform blouse; four plain unlabeled medicine boxes are lined up on the desk between them and the teacher holds an open wallet with a few peso bills; a window shows palm trees; thoughtful, respectful mood; no text in the image.

figures.teaches: Each of the four pillars acts on a different link in the chain from hyperglycemia to glomerular hypertension and fibrosis.
figures.content: Left panel: a single nephron with a glomerulus, afferent and efferent arterioles, proximal tubule and macula densa. Arrow labels in sequence: '1 More glucose and sodium reabsorbed by SGLT2 (proximal tubule)', '2 Less sodium reaches macula densa', '3 Afferent arteriole dilates; angiotensin II tightens efferent', '4 Glomerular pressure rises -> albuminuria, scarring'. Four colored badges placed on the schematic: 'SGLT2 inhibitor' at the proximal tubule ('restores feedback; afferent tone returns'); 'RASi (ACE inhibitor or ARB)' at the efferent arteriole ('efferent relaxes'); 'nsMRA (finerenone)' over the tubulointerstitium ('less inflammation and fibrosis'); 'GLP-1 RA' outside the nephron with icons ('glucose, weight, blood pressure, inflammation'). Bottom strip: 'Early eGFR dip after SGLT2 inhibitor or RASi = pressure coming down; recheck, do not reflexively stop'.

figures.teaches: The kidney protection trials translate into a few fewer serious events per 100 people over 2 to 3 years.
figures.content: Four paired 10-by-10 icon grids, one pair per trial, placebo on the left and drug on the right, event icons shaded. DAPA-CKD: placebo 14.5 of 100, dapagliflozin 9.2 of 100; caption 'median 2.4 years; NNT 19'. EMPA-KIDNEY: placebo 16.9, empagliflozin 13.1; caption 'median 2.0 years; 42 fewer per 1000 over 2 years'. FIDELIO-DKD (kidney outcome): placebo 21.1, finerenone 17.8; caption 'median 2.6 years; NNT 29 at 3 years'. FLOW: placebo 23.2, semaglutide 18.7; caption 'median 3.4 years; NNT 20 over 3 years'. Side note for CREDENCE: '43.2 vs 61.2 events per 1000 patient-years; NNT 22 over 2.5 years'. Footer warning: 'Populations, outcomes and follow-up differ; do not rank drugs by NNT alone'.
